The K=8 shortlist projection (models/production/shortlist_k8.pt) was trained on banking77 train.csv rows 0:800, seed-17 shuffle (CC-BY-4.0) per artifacts/release/manifest.json; dataset-side terms are tracked under banking77 in dataset_assets. English Choice is the audited RESEARCH RELEASE surface per the release manifest.

model_assets.source: fine-tuned from answerdotai/ModernBERT-large; training data LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions (https://huggingface.co/datasets/LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions)
model_assets.notes: Base checkpoint answerdotai/ModernBERT-large per models/production/typed-decisions/rl_agent_config.json (Apache-2.0, verified via the HF model card). Training dataset is the synthetic LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions benchmark, license apache-2.0 per its HF dataset card (verified 2026-09-29), streamed by veya/train.py and not redistributed in this repository. Fine-tuned weights ship under the project's Apache-2.0 LICENSE. Checkpoint is research-only ('research only; benchmark-specialized' per README.md; outside the audited release scope per artifacts/release/production_scope.json).

Base checkpoint recorded as jhu-clsp/mmBERT-base in models/production/multilingual/rl_agent_config.json; HF model card license tag is mit (verified 2026-09-29). mmBERT-base is a ModernBERT-architecture model trained from scratch by JHU CLSP, and its MIT grant covers the tokenizer files it distributes. The bundled multilingual tokenizer follows the Gemma-style vocabulary and special tokens (in-repo comments in research/scripts/build_benchmark_nb.py and veya/agent.py describe extra_special_tokens 'inherited from the mmBERT/Gemma tokenizer'); re-confirm the Gemma-vocabulary provenance if the tokenizer files are ever redistributed outside the mmBERT MIT grant. Checkpoint is RESEARCH ONLY per the release manifest (multilingual has no production evaluation).

redistribution_notes: Project code, checkpoints, calibration artifacts and fine-tuned weights ship under Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, sha256 recorded above; pyproject license field). All five declared runtime dependencies are permissively licensed (Apache-2.0 and BSD-family, including torch's multi-component License-Expression and numpy's 'BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0'), so the shipped runtime stack introduces no copyleft obligation. transformers, safetensors and huggingface_hub were not installed in the local .venv at scan time; their licenses were verified from PyPI-published metadata at the newest releases inside the pyproject caps (transformers 5.17.0, safetensors 0.8.0, huggingface-hub 1.33.0), all Apache-2.0. The optional [veya[train]] extra (datasets, Apache-2.0 at 3.6.0, the newest 3.x) and dev/test tooling (pytest, packaging, typing-extensions and other scan-listed packages, all permissive-style MIT/BSD/Apache/PSF) are excluded from runtime_dependencies per the G15 rule and appear as NOT_APPLICABLE in the captured scan output; transitive dependencies are likewise outside the G15 scope. Summary buckets count all inventoried entries (runtime dependencies + model assets + dataset assets = 5 + 3 + 8 = 16; permissive 9, copyleft 1, unknown 1, requires_review 5), while total_runtime_deps counts only [project.dependencies]. Model bases are Apache-2.0 (answerdotai/ModernBERT-large) and MIT (jhu-clsp/mmBERT-base), both redistribution-permitting; the shipped K=8 shortlist projection was trained on banking77 (CC-BY-4.0) rows, and this inventory makes no claim about whether dataset terms attach to model weights - dataset-side obligations are recorded under banking77 instead. Datasets redistributed inside this repository: banking77 (CC-BY-4.0), clinc150 (CC-BY-3.0), hwu64 (CC-BY-4.0), amazon_massive (CC-BY-4.0), schema_guided_dialogue (CC-BY-SA-4.0, copies at research/data/sgd and docs/audit/data/external/sgd), ag_news (license unknown) and the phase10 derived files (mixed CC-BY/CC-BY-SA). Every REQUIRES_LEGAL_REVIEW entry must be cleared by legal before redistribution outside this repository; the SGD ShareAlike clause additionally reaches adaptations such as the phase10 derived files. This inventory records evidence and per-policy status only; it is not legal advice.
